instruction: Generating and analyzing all files individually according to your instructions will involve a large number of database queries and structured JSON outputs—potentially over 300 files. This operation is technically possible but will require batching and iterative processing due to resource and output limits per request. Here’s how this can be organized: - For each filename, retrieve and analyze as per schema. - Output JSON for each file, suitable for writing to GitHub as content artifacts. - You can specify batching (e.g., 10-20 filenames per run) to avoid API or memory overload. Please confirm: - How many files per batch should be processed per run? - Should the output for each file be a separate JSON file? - Provide the destination repo or directory structure for GitHub writing, if known. Once confirmed, I’ll proceed with the first batch (for example, analyzing the first 10 files), and after each batch, repeat for subsequent batches until all files are processed.
